## About
Country Tires, also known as Used Tires Roswell, is a tire shop on Alpharetta Hwy in Roswell, right on the border of Alpharetta. We know your car is something you can't do without, so we keep our racks stocked with new and used tires for cars, vans, SUVs and trucks.
Our new tires come from major tire manufacturers, and our used tires give you another way to get rolling at a price that fits. Beyond selling tires, we balance and rotate new and used tires, check them for damage and help with flats.
Give us a call or send an email ahead of time if you have questions, and ask about our current specials.

## Services
- New and used tires: New and used tires for cars, vans, SUVs and trucks of all sizes.
- Balance and rotate tires: We balance and rotate both new and used tires.
- Tire inspection: Before a repair, we do a thorough inspection so the job is done safely.
- Flat or replace your tire: Got a flat? Bring it in, or have us put on a replacement tire.

## FAQ
Q: Can I wait while my car is being worked on?
A: Yes. Once we've worked out what you need, you're welcome to wait in our lobby until the service is done.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're on Alpharetta Hwy in Roswell, on the border of Alpharetta, across the street from Carl Black GMC.
